evaluation_priority: Visual agreement of motion direction, arc, amplitude, phase and object alignment; metrics are secondary.
method: Human-readable model inspection of actual saved images: all three-column contact sheets at +0.2, +1.0 and +2.0 s; decoded ten-frame strips of the corrected column; common-bounds plots of all 24 IDs and all 30 model steps. No continuous video playback claimed.
all10_corrected_columns_reviewed: All 18 full-case P8 movies, cup/bottle fixed (x1/3), cup/bottle oracle (cross-scene transfer column), cup H1 first-P8 (x1/3): 23 decoded strips. Other columns reviewed at the three sampled contact-sheet times, rather than claimed inspected at every time.
fixed_scaling: Reduces wide arcs in both scenes. Cup still bends right late; bottle turns/rises too early. Spatial shrinkage and step-to-frame remapping have distinct effects.
oracle_and_transfer: Better early proximity can coexist with a late endpoint below or beside the object. Future-fitted coefficients are not independent prediction results. Endpoint amplitude agreement alone does not establish a pure FPS error.
CASE_AUGE_cup: Groups 01/02 mainly lift; group 00 retains a rightward late arc. x1/3 is closer, raw outputs remain excessive. Intergroup disagreement is visible.
CASE_AUGE_bottle: Broad placement arcs persist; group 01 changes from a vertical baseline shape toward a rightward arc. Correction reduces amplitude but leaves early placement and shape error.
CASE_NOK_cup: All three groups mainly lift upward and are more coherent. x1/3 stays near the cup; early lift remains too fast/high.
CASE_NOK_bottle: All groups retain broad rightward placement arcs. Correction improves proximity without matching middle-frame direction and timing.
CASE_NOK_STRICT_cup: Fresh trust/filter/smoothing preserves the upward motion seen in ray-only MoGe. All corrected groups approach the cup; early phase remains too fast, group 02 is lower late. No uniform superiority over ray-only MoGe across time.
CASE_NOK_STRICT_bottle: Fresh geometry does not remove the broad rightward arc. Corrected trajectories turn toward the pot early and remain displaced from the bottle, with differing late group endpoints.

strict_flagged_ID30.finding: Its prediction has the same broad misplaced arc; x1/3 reduces it but leaves a low/right late endpoint. Fresh native Z has a 12 mm step followed by a plateau; smoother preserves image rays and alters H3 position by up to 8.20 mm. The outlier flag remains a depth/eligibility limitation, not certified away by visual review.

H1_cup_first_8: Premature large placement arc persists and x1/3 still ends right of the lifting cup. Changing history and checkpoint together does not isolate a causal factor.
ShareRobot_finding: Same physical scenes and poses in paired images; independent exact decoded RGB SHA256 proves all 60 frames match unique original source indices.
limitations: Two selected scenes do not establish universal calibration or a single FPS cause.
Corrected MolmoMotion does not surpass constant velocity on these references.
Kalib applicability audited; no actual calibration without verified TCP correspondences.
Future reference is tracker-based, and 3D_est uses measured sensor Z with estimated camera rays.
